scope: Real model -> Gateway -> Main -> driver -> toolResult chain plus MCP stdio protocol. Live leg is now demonstrated end to end against an authorized local endpoint.

mcpProtocol.scope: MCP stdio protocol + capability filtering; not a model or packaged-app claim

requestBodyBoundary.defect: The OpenAI-family transports wrote the caller AbortSignal into the request body (params.signal = options.signal). Strict OpenAI-compatible upstreams reject that with 500 "Unexpected keyword argument 'signal'".
requestBodyBoundary.isolationProof: Same endpoint, same model: body without signal -> HTTP 200; body with signal -> HTTP 500. Captured through a recording proxy in front of the live endpoint.
requestBodyBoundary.fix: signal is passed as the SDK request option instead of a payload field; cancellation semantics preserved, internal control no longer serialized.
